trap.label: preposição + -ing
trap.wrong: Instead of use the score, I listed my priorities.
trap.right: Instead of using the score, I listed my priorities.
trap.why: Em português “em vez de usar” leva infinitivo. Em inglês, depois de instead of (preposição) use -ing.

mcq.q: “Then, and only then, ___ I let feelings decide.”

fix.wrong: Only then I let feelings decide.
fix.right: Only then did I let feelings decide.

fix.wrong: I decided by listing than choosing.
fix.right: I decided by listing rather than choosing.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com instead of: “I listed priorities. I did not use scores.”
rewrite.answer: Instead of using scores, I listed priorities.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Only then: “I let feelings decide then.”
rewrite.answer: Only then did I let feelings decide.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “My favourite comes last.”
